name: worldlabs
description: Create with Atlas APIs and tools

interface.longDescription: Use the World Labs CLI to generate and edit images, estimate cameras and depth, and work with API tasks and assets. Connect to the Atlas Blender add-on to inspect RGBD frames, arrange scenes, generate views, and build editable grayboxes. API workflows require Node.js 24+, the World Labs CLI, and an API key with task access. Blender workflows require local shell access, Python 3.10+, and Blender 5.1+ with Atlas enabled. Tools are installed separately from this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show me which World Labs API tasks are available.
Inspect the frames in my open Atlas Blender scene.
Build a graybox from my Atlas images.
